node.label: Impaired cerebroside sulfate hydrolysis
node.definition: Reduced hydrolysis (splitting of a bond and the addition of the hydrogen anion of water) of the sulfuric ester linkage in the molecule of cerebroside sulfate, possibly leading to accumuation of cerebroside sulfate.

evidence.snippet: Metachromatic leukodystrophy: Impaired cerebroside sulfate hydrolysis [PCS]
